cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Let the Callback Claim Credit
cards.instruction: Get recognition by returning to an early overlooked contribution when its importance becomes undeniable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Remember my suggestion to put the spare key under the flowerpot?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. And now we're locked out beside a very useful flowerpot.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say whose idea while you lift it. The pot can't accept all the credit.

mechanism: A uses a once-dismissed spare-key lesson to coach its pupil from acknowledging a useful idea to naming A as its source during the lockout.
confusable: Not generic demand for praise: the earlier overlooked suggestion now solves the immediate problem and A brings that same contribution back.
comparison: Spare-key rescue versus earlier untidy tape saving curtain.
